name: private-session
description: Always start Spotify with Private Session active.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run copy && spicetify config extensions private-session.js && spicetify apply
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:dev && npm run copy && spicetify config extensions private-session.js && spicetify apply && spicetify enable-devtools
scripts.undeploy: rm -f "$(spicetify path userdata)/Extensions/private-session.js" && spicetify config extensions private-session.js- && spicetify apply
